# Damage Roll

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Damage and Healing](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#DamageRoll)*

A damage roll is a die roll, adjusted by any applicable modifiers, that deals damage to a target. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Damage and Healing](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#DamageRolls)").
